label: consumption-probe
_why: Tests whether pop consumption can be read DIRECTLY instead of as a residual. Our scenario calibration derives pop demand as (buy orders - our modelled building demand - trade), so every building-model error is scored as pop error; the market panel splits buy orders by source with pop consumption as an explicit entry. If GetMarketBuyOrdersBreakdown resolves in a debug_log, both modelled terms are replaced by the game's own numbers.
_note: Belgium (the clean, hand-checkable market) and Japan (the one market whose error is a ~1.6x level shortfall rather than distribution noise). Short span - the probe only needs one dump to answer whether the calls resolve.
